prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE small underground hospital environment for a STRICT SIDE-ON2D ACTION PLATFORMER, an orthographic SIDE ELEVATION / cutaway.
The camera looks HORIZONTALLY at the BACK WALLS at character chest-height. Walkable floors are SINGLE HORIZONTAL LINES / narrow slabs. There is NO visible floor-plane depth and NO top-down furniture. Every bed's LONG MATTRESS AXIS is HORIZONTAL left-right, with a headboard at one end and short legs below. Desks, seats, cabinets, surgical tables and sinks are shown in their SIDE PROFILE / FRONT ELEVATION. You cannot see the top surfaces of mattresses or desks.
Do NOT make an overhead RPG map, isometric dollhouse, axonometric rooms, architectural floor plan or3D rendering. This is a playable-looking2D platformer backdrop.

Same hospital identity: small poor underground District C clinic in2040, EMPTY, cold oppressive blue-gray/noir pixel art. SIX rooms in TWO basement levels, not a huge complex. It corresponds to a top-down version with reception / treatment / physician office along the north and stairwell / ward / medical storage along the south. Recreate these exact six zones and their key props in side projection.

Canvas640x360 NATIVEpixels. Deliver1280x720 or2560x1440 as exact nearest-neighbor integer enlarged native squares. Existing protagonist stands24-28NATIVEpixels tall. Doors32-38px tall, bed mattress44-50px LONG horizontally and only6-8px thick, beds with legs14-18px totalheight; desk22-26px high. Keep all props on the floor at this small scale.

TOP LEVEL floor line y164:
Left x16..188 reception/waiting room: battered desk with tiny cyan CRT, empty chairs, cabinet, gray steel door.
Middle x196..410 treatment room: narrow EMPTY horizontal operating/exam table in SIDE PROFILE, low wheeled medical monitor, articulated lamp overhead, sink, plain drawer cart.
Right x420..624 physician office: old desk and dim CRT, EMPTY office chair, filing cabinets and book/document shelves, metal exit door.

BOTTOM LEVEL floor line y344:
Left x16..126 entrance/service stair: industrial staircase with landings ascending to top level and a simple electrical breaker panel, exposed pipes, entry steel door.
Middle x138..398 ward: THREE EMPTY horizontal side-profile hospital beds spaced along same floor, flat dark thin blankets with pillows at one END, IV stand silhouettes, drawn curtain rails.
Right x410..624 cold medical storage/lab: two closed refrigeration cabinets, plain sealed supply boxes on shelves, steel workbench and small sink; no biological contents.

Architecture: upper and lower rooms are part of ONE connected cutaway with worn concrete beams, narrow structural floor slabs, wall openings/doors between rooms. West service stair connects the two levels. A few intermediate landings at about30nativepx height differences make the stair traversal credible. A small raised maintenance ledge above part of treatment/office with short ladder access and a large wall ventilation grille; one short10-12px gap as futureparkour detail. A single clinical access shutter and an electrical switch box as futurepuzzle detail. Keep it modest and readable, following original small six-room concept.

Palette: near-black navy #0c141c, cold charcoal #192630, steel blue-gray #3d5260,#647c88, dirty desaturated medical green #3e5559, pale cold cyan screens #70bcc7, at most a few muted red indicator pixels.32-40meaningful flat colors maximum. Dark niches, restricted short DOWNWARD fluorescent pools, restrained cluster shading, sparse cracks/stains/pipes/conduit. Crisp one-native-pixel edges. No warm light, cozy decoration, plants or sunlight.
ABSOLUTELY ZERO people, hero, player, NPC, staff, patient, silhouette, mannequin, corpse, blood, gore, organs, weapons. Allbeds/chairs/tablesempty.
No text, room labels, captions, HUD, UI, arrows, legends, coordinates, grids, watermarks or logos.
No smooth gradients, antialiasing, painterly noise, bloom, blur, photorealism or subpixel detail.
Deliver one finished complete16:9 SIDE-ON hospital cutaway image. The HORIZONTAL side-profile beds and thin horizontal floor slabs must unmistakably prove the camera is SIDEVIEW.
